notes.detail: All places[].deaths, their people/labels, derived negative-ID death entries, and category=death standalone places must be redacted independently of this curated list. Name, image, caption, alt, aria-label, selected map label, tooltip, route stop and people-page association can each leak the same fact.

A home/workplace with a death remains an ordinary home/workplace. Curated field lists identify embedded spoilers beyond the separately generated death row; do not automatically obscure all innocent base location names because a death happened there.

Shared-site appearances need separate handling:37 Reservoir Dogs has an undercover reveal while The Big Lebowski coffee-shop visit is innocent;96 The Player has murder relationships while La La Land cinema date is innocent.

The exact alias Alexander Revelle / Sam Bouchard appears in447 and451 and must not leak in the global People list, a person page heading, search result, tooltip, link label, or accessible name while spoilers are off. Likewise Diane Selwyn / Betty Elms / Rita associations at88 and90 reveal identity connections.

A redacted visible span over still-present text leaves aria labels, title attributes, image alt and copied text readable. Source href/imageUrl basename can reveal words in browser link preview, e.g58 Ending.JPG,43 Murder+Apartment+3.JPG,419 Shooting.JPG. Keep spoiler data out of the rendered text/attributes and cover or disable spoiler image enlargement/metadata while off; broad external source pages may independently contain spoilers.

Dead Again, Kiss Me Deadly, Body Double and What Ever Happened to Baby Jane? are titles, not spoilers.496 Fisher & Sons Funeral Home is the premise of Six Feet Under, not a death outcome.512 Santa Clarita Diet zombie premise is not hidden by this audit. Ordinary robberies/chases, theatres, schools and workplaces are not all marked merely because they are plot locations.

This is a metadata/content audit; images were not individually inspected here. For an explicitly spoiler-marked scene or death record, cover its screen image and prevent enlargement until opt-in. A normal site photograph can remain unless its caption/alt/person-association gives away the spoiler. The sibling death record often reuses the same innocent building photo.

All362places and all6journeys were enumerated and their prose searched/reviewed. This audit is intentionally conservative for late endings/revelations, but avoids treating every ordinary set-piece action as a twist. It does not add or change factual story content.
